evidence.quote: Owned intelligence is not the same as rented intelligence.

observations.why: The owned/rented opposition frames intelligence as a proportional cost-benefit distinction — what you keep versus what you pay to access — enacting market-pricing logic.

evidence.quote: the perspective is the asset you keep.

observations.why: Calling perspective an 'asset you keep' continues the proportionality frame — valuing what is retained against what is commoditized — a cost-benefit allocation move.
